_comment: Auth: each shot accepts an optional storageState path to a Playwright storage-state JSON file, e.g. { name: gallery-mine, path: /, waitFor: main, storageState: scripts/screenshots/auth-exhibit.json }. Set auth.storageState to sign in every shot that omits its own. Null (default) captures signed out; docs pages are public and need no auth. See scripts/screenshots/README.md for the one-time headed-login runbook. JSON has no comments, so this _comment field carries the example.
